dropped_claims.claim: The compensation system covers roughly half of total reindeer losses to predators.
dropped_claims.reason: episode_span not found in final episode text

claims.claim: Finland pays 1.5 times market value for each documented predator-killed reindeer plus separate calf-loss compensation under the Game Animal Damages Act 105/2009.
claims.supporting_quote: The compensation on damages to reindeer is not more than the current value of the reindeer multiplied with 1.5.

claims.claim: Lichen biomass on the Finnish side of the Finnish–Norwegian border fence is now approximately one-third the level found on the Norwegian winter pasture.
claims.episode_span: Studies of the Finnish–Norwegian border fence show that lichen biomass on the Finnish side, where year-round grazing is permitted, has fallen to roughly one-third the level recorded on the Norwegian side that enforces strict seasonal rotation.
claims.source_title: Reconstructing the historical decline of lichen cover across the reindeer fence of the Finnish–Norwegian border
claims.supporting_quote: At present, lichen biomass is approximately three times greater in the Norwegian winter pasture than in the Finnish herding district.
